{"id":1848419569,"question_id":4100,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765032840,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1848419569/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Complete Prime Number","memory":"9.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isPrime(long long n)\n    {\n        if(n <= 1) return false;\n        if(n <= 3) return true;\n        if(n % 2 == 0 or n % 3 == 0) return false;\n\n        for(long long i=5 ; i*i<=n ; i+=6){\n            if(n % i == 0 or n %(i+2) == 0) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n    bool completePrime(int num) {\n        string s = to_string(num);\n        int n = s.size();\n\n        long long prefix = 0;\n        for(int i=0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            prefix = prefix * 10 + (s[i] - '0');\n            if(!isPrime(prefix)) return false;\n        }\n\n        long long suffix = 0 , place = 1;\n        for(int i=n-1 ; i >= 0 ; i--){\n            suffix = (s[i] - '0') * place + suffix;\n            place *= 10;\n            if(!isPrime(suffix)) return false;\n        }\n\n        return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"complete-prime-number","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1237}
